```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "left")
source(file.path("R", "common.R"))
library(knitr)
library(ggrepel)
details <- function(df, summary = "table") {
  knitr::asis_output(paste0("<details><summary>", summary, "</summary>\n\n",
                            paste(knitr::kable(df, format = "html"), collapse = "\n"), "\n\n</details>\n"))
}
p1 <- function(x) formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = 1)  # share -> percent, 1 decimal
p2 <- function(x) formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = 2)
```

This notebook supports the Results subsections *Minimum ORF length and target-decoy acceptance of
ORFs* and *Small inputs and presets*
([results_short_orfs.tex](../manuscript/sections/results_short_orfs.tex)), the q-value paragraphs
of the Methods ([methods_algorithm.tex](../manuscript/sections/methods_algorithm.tex), *ORF
selection*, *Target-decoy q-values*, *Presets for small inputs*) and Fig. 4
(`figures/fig4_short_orfs.{pdf,png}`).

Which data each part uses:

- **Release runs** (`r evidence("E25")`; PyTD 3a793ff, identical to Perl 41fc5ee on all 84 inputs):
  `data/benchmark/final_v7/negatives_scores.tsv` (default q 0.05 = `pytd_v7`, `--precise` q 0.01,
  `--sensitive` q 0.2, plus the development runs `cliff_c200` and `dev_q*` scored the same way), and
  tables derived from the release predictions by `pipeline/derive/04_release_short_orfs.sh`
  (`by_length.v7.tsv`, `sens_by_length.v7.tsv`, `lnc_by_era.human.v7.tsv`,
  `lnc_call_lengths.human.tsv`, `lnc_riboseq_orfs.v7.tsv`).
- **Development runs, no release equivalent**: the minimum-length sweep (100 to 50 codons;
  `short_orf_summary.tsv`, `by_length.tsv`; `r evidence("E04")`), the q sweep from 0.01 to 0.5 and the
  longest-ORF baselines (`qmodes/`; `r evidence("E22")`), the decoy prototype and calibration
  (`rules/`; `r evidence("E20")`) and the held-out preset test (`presets/`; `r evidence("E21")`).
  These were run with the same rule but an earlier random number generator (E24); where a release
  value exists it is shown next to the development value.

"Fixed short-ORF test" is the development default before the q-value test (`cliff_c200`: 50-codon
minimum, frame contrast of at least 200·μ below 100 codons; `m50+g200` in E04).

```{r data}
N_LNC <- c(human = 33668, mouse = 31467)
N_RAND <- c(human = 19167, mouse = 21409, dmel = 13884, athal = 26867, spombe = 5100,
            tthermophila = 26456, pfalciparum = 5281, creinhardtii = 17621)
VARS <- c("complete.wRand", "fragments.wRand", "complete.wLnc", "fragments.wLnc")
VAR_LABEL <- c(complete.wRand = "complete + random", fragments.wRand = "fragments + random",
               complete.wLnc = "complete + lncRNA", fragments.wLnc = "fragments + lncRNA")
REL_LABEL <- c(precise = "--precise (q 0.01)", pytd_v7 = "default (q 0.05)",
               sensitive = "--sensitive (q 0.2)")

sos <- read_tab("benchmark", "short_orf_summary.tsv")
bylen <- read_tab("benchmark", "by_length.tsv")
bylen7 <- read_tab("benchmark", "final_v7", "by_length.v7.tsv")
neg7 <- read_tab("benchmark", "final_v7", "negatives_scores.tsv")
qmed <- read_tab("benchmark", "qmodes", "qmodes.medians.tsv")
cal <- read_tab("benchmark", "rules", "decoy_calibration.per_input.tsv")
sbl <- read_tab("benchmark", "rules", "sens_by_length.decoy.tsv")
sbl7 <- read_tab("benchmark", "final_v7", "sens_by_length.v7.tsv")
lnc_len <- read_tab("benchmark", "final_v7", "lnc_call_lengths.human.tsv")
ribo_dev <- read_tab("benchmark", "rules", "lnc_riboseq_orfs.tsv")
ribo7 <- read_tab("benchmark", "final_v7", "lnc_riboseq_orfs.v7.tsv")
era7 <- read_tab("benchmark", "final_v7", "lnc_by_era.human.v7.tsv")
presets <- read_tab("benchmark", "presets", "preset_scores.tsv") %>%
  mutate(set = sub("\\.r[0-9]+$", "", variant))

# short_orf_summary.awk applied to by_length.v7.tsv (release runs)
summarise_bylen <- function(b) {
  b %>% group_by(org, v = variant, tool) %>%
    summarise(sens_all = sum(tp_stop[kind == "truth"]) / sum(n[kind == "truth"]),
              sens_short = sum(tp_stop[kind == "truth" & grepl("^[5-9]0-", bin)]) /
                sum(n[kind == "truth" & grepl("^[5-9]0-", bin)]),
              neg = sum(fp_negative[kind == "pred"]), fp_real = sum(fp_real[kind == "pred"]),
              tp = sum(tp_stop[kind == "pred"]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(prec = tp / (tp + fp_real + neg))
}
sos7 <- summarise_bylen(bylen7) %>%
  mutate(cfg = recode(tool, pytd_v7 = "q0.05", pytd_v7_precise = "q0.01", pytd_v7_sensitive = "q0.2"))

# medians over organisms of the release and development runs scored by score_negatives.py
med7 <- neg7 %>% group_by(variant, label) %>%
  summarise(across(c(sens_stop, sens_exact, precision_stop, neg_rate), median), n_orgs = n(),
            .groups = "drop")
m7 <- function(v, l, col) med7[[col]][med7$variant == v & med7$label == l]
mq <- function(v, l, col) qmed[[col]][qmed$variant == v & qmed$label == l]
```

## Random sequence understates the cost of short ORFs

Development minimum-length sweep (`r evidence("E04")`; no release rerun exists for LongOrfs minima
other than 50). `neg` counts predictions on negatives; one random sequence per truth transcript.

```{r para-random}
s <- function(o, v, cfg, col) sos[[col]][sos$org == o & sos$v == v & sos$cfg == cfg]
rand_m50 <- sos %>% filter(v == "complete.wRand", cfg == "m50") %>%
  mutate(n_rand = N_RAND[org], per_seq = neg / n_rand) %>% arrange(per_seq)
h_sens100 <- s("human", "complete.wLnc", "m100", "sens_short")
h_sens50 <- s("human", "complete.wLnc", "m50", "sens_short")
h_lnc100 <- s("human", "complete.wLnc", "m100", "neg")
h_lnc50 <- s("human", "complete.wLnc", "m50", "neg")
h_prec100 <- s("human", "complete.wLnc", "m100", "prec")
h_prec50 <- s("human", "complete.wLnc", "m50", "prec")
short_bins <- c("50-59", "60-69", "70-79", "80-89", "90-99")
bl50 <- bylen %>% filter(org == "human", variant == "complete.wLnc", tool == "pytd_dev_m50",
                         kind == "pred", bin %in% short_bins)
lnc_short <- sum(bl50$fp_negative)
tp_short <- sum(bl50$tp_stop)
# release default, human complete.wLnc, for comparison
r7 <- sos7 %>% filter(org == "human", v == "complete.wLnc", cfg == "q0.05")
check_text("random calls per sequence at 50 codons, min", round(min(rand_m50$per_seq), 3), 0.013)
check_text("random calls per sequence at 50 codons, max", round(max(rand_m50$per_seq), 3), 0.159)
check_text("human lncRNA negatives", N_LNC[["human"]], 33668)
check_text("human 50-99 aa sensitivity, 100 codons", round(h_sens100, 2), 0.31)
check_text("human 50-99 aa sensitivity, 50 codons", round(h_sens50, 2), 0.86)
check_text("human lncRNAs with prediction, 100 codons (%)", round(100 * h_lnc100 / N_LNC[["human"]], 1), 19.6)
check_text("human lncRNAs with prediction, 50 codons (%)", round(100 * h_lnc50 / N_LNC[["human"]], 1), 63.6)
check_text("human precision, 100 codons", round(h_prec100, 2), 0.74)
check_text("human precision, 50 codons", round(h_prec50, 2), 0.47)
check_text("lncRNA calls of 50-99 aa at 50 codons", lnc_short, 14880)
check_text("correct calls of 50-99 aa at 50 codons", tp_short, 430)
```

- At a 50-codon minimum, `r f3(min(rand_m50$per_seq))`–`r f3(max(rand_m50$per_seq))` calls per
  GC-matched random sequence (`r ORG_LABEL[rand_m50$org[1]]` `r num(rand_m50$neg[1])` /
  `r num(rand_m50$n_rand[1])` to `r ORG_LABEL[last(rand_m50$org)]` `r num(last(rand_m50$neg))` /
  `r num(last(rand_m50$n_rand))`).
- Human complete transcripts with `r num(N_LNC[["human"]])` lncRNA negatives, 100 → 50 codons:
  sensitivity for true proteins of 50–99 aa `r f3(h_sens100)` → `r f3(h_sens50)`; lncRNAs with a
  prediction `r num(h_lnc100)` (`r p1(h_lnc100 / N_LNC[["human"]])`%) → `r num(h_lnc50)`
  (`r p1(h_lnc50 / N_LNC[["human"]])`%); precision `r f3(h_prec100)` → `r f3(h_prec50)`.
- In the 50–99 aa range at 50 codons: `r num(lnc_short)` lncRNA calls against `r num(tp_short)`
  correct calls.
- For comparison, the release default (q 0.05) on the same input: 50–99 aa sensitivity
  `r f3(r7$sens_short)`, `r num(r7$neg)` lncRNAs with a prediction
  (`r p1(r7$neg / N_LNC[["human"]])`%), precision `r f3(r7$prec)` (`by_length.v7.tsv`).

The minimum-length sweep exists only as development runs (no release rerun of LongOrfs minima other
than 50), so the paragraph's numbers stay on the sweep. The release q settings (q 0.01, 0.05, 0.2) are
added to Fig. 4a,b as the blue paths and the release default to Fig. 4c (section *Figure 4*); the
earlier \todo asking for this update has been resolved in the text and the caption.

## A target-decoy test for every ORF

Medians over organisms (eight with random negatives, human and mouse with lncRNA negatives).
"release" is `pytd_v7` (E25), the run the manuscript quotes; "fixed" is `cliff_c200`; "dev q 0.05" is
the development run an earlier draft quoted (`decoy_q0.05_longgc`, E20/E22), rescored in the same file.

```{r para-decoy}
tab_decoy <- med7 %>% filter(label %in% c("pytd_v7", "dev_q0.05", "cliff_c200")) %>%
  mutate(label = recode(label, pytd_v7 = "release q 0.05", dev_q0.05 = "dev q 0.05",
                        cliff_c200 = "fixed short-ORF test"),
         variant = factor(variant, VARS), neg_pct = round(100 * neg_rate, 2)) %>%
  arrange(variant, label) %>% select(variant, label, sens_stop, sens_exact, neg_pct, n_orgs)
kable(tab_decoy, digits = 3, col.names = c("input", "setting", "stop sens.", "exact sens.",
                                           "% negatives with prediction", "organisms"))
rel <- function(v, col) m7(v, "pytd_v7", col)
fix <- function(v, col) m7(v, "cliff_c200", col)
# values quoted in the bullet list (release q 0.05 against the fixed short-ORF test)
quoted <- tribble(
  ~variant, ~col, ~q_rel, ~q_fix,
  "complete.wRand", "sens_stop", 0.964, 0.957,
  "complete.wRand", "sens_exact", 0.899, 0.897,
  "complete.wRand", "neg_rate", 0.29, 0.48,
  "fragments.wRand", "sens_stop", 0.872, 0.815,
  "fragments.wRand", "sens_exact", 0.772, 0.708,
  "fragments.wRand", "neg_rate", 0.23, 0.11,
  "complete.wLnc", "neg_rate", 5.0, 18.9,
  "fragments.wLnc", "neg_rate", 5.9, 18.7,
  "complete.wLnc", "sens_stop", 0.963, 0.976,
  "fragments.wLnc", "sens_stop", 0.858, 0.858)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(quoted))) {
  q <- quoted[i, ]
  isneg <- q$col == "neg_rate"
  sc <- if (isneg) 100 else 1
  dg <- if (isneg) (if (grepl("Lnc", q$variant)) 1 else 2) else 3
  check_text(sprintf("%s %s, q-value test", VAR_LABEL[[q$variant]], q$col),
             round(sc * rel(q$variant, q$col), dg), q$q_rel)
  # exact value compared at half a unit of the quoted digit (medians such as 0.1865 round either way)
  check_text(sprintf("%s %s, fixed short-ORF test", VAR_LABEL[[q$variant]], q$col),
             sc * fix(q$variant, q$col), q$q_fix, tol = 0.5 * 10^-dg)
}
```

Release values: complete + random stop `r f3(rel("complete.wRand", "sens_stop"))` against
`r f3(fix("complete.wRand", "sens_stop"))`, exact `r f3(rel("complete.wRand", "sens_exact"))`
against `r f3(fix("complete.wRand", "sens_exact"))`, `r p2(rel("complete.wRand", "neg_rate"))`%
against `r p2(fix("complete.wRand", "neg_rate"))`% of random sequences; fragments + random stop
`r f3(rel("fragments.wRand", "sens_stop"))` against `r f3(fix("fragments.wRand", "sens_stop"))`,
exact `r f3(rel("fragments.wRand", "sens_exact"))` against `r f3(fix("fragments.wRand", "sens_exact"))`,
at `r p2(rel("fragments.wRand", "neg_rate"))`% against `r p2(fix("fragments.wRand", "neg_rate"))`%;
lncRNA negatives `r p1(rel("complete.wLnc", "neg_rate"))`% against
`r p1(fix("complete.wLnc", "neg_rate"))`% (complete) and `r p1(rel("fragments.wLnc", "neg_rate"))`%
against `r p1(fix("fragments.wLnc", "neg_rate"))`% (fragments), at stop sensitivity
`r f3(rel("complete.wLnc", "sens_stop"))` against `r f3(fix("complete.wLnc", "sens_stop"))` and
`r f3(rel("fragments.wLnc", "sens_stop"))` against `r f3(fix("fragments.wLnc", "sens_stop"))`.
`r evidence("E25")`, `r evidence("E20")`.

### Strata: transcript length matters on fragments

Prototype post-filter (`rules/decoy_proto/`, `r evidence("E20")`): stop sensitivity on fragments with
strata of ORF length only (`len`) against ORF length × transcript length × ORF type (`len_tx_type`,
the release strata), at the same q.

```{r strata}
proto_files <- list.files(data_path("benchmark", "rules", "decoy_proto"), pattern = "fragments.*\\.di\\.len",
                          full.names = TRUE)
proto <- bind_rows(lapply(proto_files, read_tsv, show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  tidyr::separate(label, c("org", "variant", "strata"), sep = "\\.", extra = "merge") %>%
  mutate(variant = paste(variant, sub("\\..*", "", strata), sep = "."), strata = sub(".*\\.", "", strata))
proto_gain <- proto %>% filter(q_cutoff %in% c(0.05, 0.1)) %>%
  select(org, variant, strata, q_cutoff, sens_stop) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = strata, values_from = sens_stop) %>%
  mutate(gain_tx_type = 100 * (len_tx_type - len), gain_tx = 100 * (len_tx - len))
kable(proto_gain, digits = 3)
```

Adding transcript length and ORF type to the strata raised stop sensitivity on fragments by
`r f1(min(proto_gain$gain_tx_type))`–`r f1(max(proto_gain$gain_tx_type))` points
(`r paste(unique(proto_gain$org), collapse = ", ")`; q 0.05 and 0.1). The text's "5–6 points"
matches the median (`r f1(median(proto_gain$gain_tx_type))`).

```{r strata-check}
check_text("strata gain on fragments, points (median, text 5-6)", round(median(proto_gain$gain_tx_type)),
           5.5, tol = 0.5)
```

### Sensitivity by CDS length

Pooled over organisms, stop sensitivity for true CDSs of 50–74 codons (`sens_by_length.py`;
development `rules/sens_by_length.decoy.tsv` and release `final_v7/sens_by_length.v7.tsv`).

```{r bylength}
sbl_all <- bind_rows(sbl %>% mutate(source = "development"),
                     sbl7 %>% filter(label != "cliff_c200") %>% mutate(source = "release")) %>%
  filter(set == "coding") %>%
  group_by(source, variant, label, length_bin) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), hits = sum(hits), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(sens = hits / n)
lb <- function(v, l, b) sbl_all$sens[sbl_all$variant == v & sbl_all$label == l & sbl_all$length_bin == b]
tab_len <- sbl_all %>% filter(length_bin %in% c("50-74", "75-99", "100-124")) %>%
  select(-hits) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = length_bin, values_from = c(sens, n)) %>%
  mutate(variant = factor(variant, VARS)) %>% arrange(variant, source, label)
details(tab_len %>% mutate(across(starts_with("sens"), ~ round(.x, 3))), "sensitivity by CDS length (50-124 codons)")
check_text("fragments 50-74 codon sensitivity, fixed test", round(lb("fragments.wRand", "cliff_c200", "50-74"), 2), 0.27)
check_text("fragments 50-74 codon sensitivity, q 0.1 (dev)", round(lb("fragments.wRand", "decoy_q0.1", "50-74"), 2), 0.62)
```

Fragments with random negatives, 50–74 codons: `r f3(lb("fragments.wRand", "cliff_c200", "50-74"))`
with the fixed test, `r f3(lb("fragments.wRand", "decoy_q0.1", "50-74"))` at development q 0.1 (the
value quoted), and in the release runs `r f3(lb("fragments.wRand", "pytd_v7_precise", "50-74"))`,
`r f3(lb("fragments.wRand", "pytd_v7", "50-74"))` and `r f3(lb("fragments.wRand", "pytd_v7_sensitive", "50-74"))`
at q 0.01, 0.05 and 0.2. There is no release run at q 0.1. On complete + lncRNA inputs, the fixed
test is higher at 100–124 codons (`r f3(lb("complete.wLnc", "cliff_c200", "100-124"))` against
`r f3(lb("complete.wLnc", "pytd_v7", "100-124"))` for the release default), where it accepted
any positive contrast.

### Calibration

Observed false-discovery rate = 1 − stop precision of the final predictions, median per input type.

```{r calibration}
cal_dev <- cal %>% filter(label %in% c("decoy_q0.01", "decoy_q0.05", "decoy_q0.1", "decoy_q0.2")) %>%
  group_by(variant, label) %>% summarise(observed_fdr = median(observed_fdr_stop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(source = "development", q = as.numeric(sub("decoy_q", "", label)))
cal_rel <- neg7 %>% filter(label %in% names(REL_LABEL)) %>% group_by(variant, label) %>%
  summarise(observed_fdr = median(1 - precision_stop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(source = "release", q = c(precise = 0.01, pytd_v7 = 0.05, sensitive = 0.2)[label])
cal_tab <- bind_rows(cal_dev, cal_rel) %>% select(source, variant, q, observed_fdr) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variant, values_from = observed_fdr) %>% arrange(source, q)
kable(cal_tab, digits = 4)
cd <- function(v) cal_dev$observed_fdr[cal_dev$variant == v & cal_dev$label == "decoy_q0.1"]
check_text("observed FDR complete + lncRNA at q 0.1", round(cd("complete.wLnc"), 3), 0.089)
check_text("observed FDR fragments + lncRNA at q 0.1", round(cd("fragments.wLnc"), 3), 0.121)
check_text("observed FDR complete + random at q 0.1", round(cd("complete.wRand"), 3), 0.006)
check_text("observed FDR fragments + random at q 0.1", round(cd("fragments.wRand"), 3), 0.009)
```

At a nominal 0.1 (development, `decoy_q0.1` without the long-ORF rule, as E20): observed
`r f3(cd("complete.wLnc"))` and `r f3(cd("fragments.wLnc"))` on lncRNA negatives,
`r f3(cd("complete.wRand"))` and `r f3(cd("fragments.wRand"))` on random negatives. The release runs
at q 0.05 give `r f3(cal_rel$observed_fdr[cal_rel$variant == "complete.wLnc" & cal_rel$label == "pytd_v7"])`
and `r f3(cal_rel$observed_fdr[cal_rel$variant == "fragments.wLnc" & cal_rel$label == "pytd_v7"])`
on lncRNA negatives. Note that the q-values are computed over all candidate ORFs, while the observed
rate is over the one selected per transcript.

## One setting

```{r para-one}
d_lnc <- function(v) 100 * (m7(v, "pytd_v7", "sens_stop") - m7(v, "precise", "sens_stop"))
d_lnc_dev <- function(v) 100 * (m7(v, "dev_q0.05", "sens_stop") - m7(v, "dev_q0.01", "sens_stop"))
ll <- function(l, col, v = "complete.wLnc") lnc_len[[col]][lnc_len$label == l & lnc_len$variant == v]
lo100 <- function(v, col) mq(v, "longest_orf_m100", col)
kable(lnc_len, caption = "Human lncRNA calls by predicted ORF length (codons, stop included)")
check_text("--precise lncRNA calls, complete (%)", round(100 * m7("complete.wLnc", "precise", "neg_rate"), 1), 4.2)
check_text("--precise lncRNA calls, fragments (%)", round(100 * m7("fragments.wLnc", "precise", "neg_rate"), 1), 4.6)
check_text("--precise stop sensitivity cost, complete + lncRNA (points)", round(d_lnc("complete.wLnc"), 1), 1.3)
check_text("--precise stop sensitivity cost, fragments + lncRNA (points)", round(d_lnc("fragments.wLnc"), 1), 6.4)
check_text("human lncRNA calls >= 200 codons at q 0.01", ll("pytd_v7_precise", "ge200"), 623)
check_text("human lncRNA calls at q 0.01", ll("pytd_v7_precise", "n_lnc_calls"), 1378)
check_text("human lncRNA calls >= 300 codons at q 0.01", ll("pytd_v7_precise", "ge300"), 236)
check_text("human lncRNA calls >= 300 codons at q 0.3 (dev only)", ll("decoy_q0.3_longgc", "ge300"), 234)
check_text("--sensitive fragments + random stop sensitivity", round(m7("fragments.wRand", "sensitive", "sens_stop"), 3), 0.895)
check_text("q 0.3 fragments + random stop sensitivity (dev only)", mq("fragments.wRand", "decoy_q0.3", "sens_stop"), 0.898, tol = 0.0005)
check_text("q 0.5 fragments + random stop sensitivity (dev only)", round(mq("fragments.wRand", "decoy_q0.5", "sens_stop"), 3), 0.898)
check_text("--sensitive lncRNA calls, complete (%)", round(100 * m7("complete.wLnc", "sensitive", "neg_rate"), 1), 7.8)
check_text("--sensitive lncRNA calls, fragments (%)", round(100 * m7("fragments.wLnc", "sensitive", "neg_rate"), 1), 10.2)
check_text("--sensitive random calls below 0.5% (max of complete/fragments, %)",
           as.numeric(100 * max(m7("complete.wRand", "sensitive", "neg_rate"), m7("fragments.wRand", "sensitive", "neg_rate")) < 0.5), 1)
check_text("longest ORF >= 100 codons, random calls complete (%)", round(100 * lo100("complete.wRand", "neg_rate")), 22)
check_text("longest ORF >= 100 codons, random calls fragments (%)", round(100 * lo100("fragments.wRand", "neg_rate")), 11)
check_text("longest ORF >= 100 codons, lncRNA calls (%)", round(100 * lo100("complete.wLnc", "neg_rate")), 26)
check_text("longest ORF >= 100 codons, stop sens complete + random", round(lo100("complete.wRand", "sens_stop"), 3), 0.954)
check_text("longest ORF >= 100 codons, stop sens fragments + random", round(lo100("fragments.wRand", "sens_stop"), 3), 0.759)
```

- `--precise` (release): lncRNA calls `r p1(m7("complete.wLnc", "precise", "neg_rate"))`% and
  `r p1(m7("fragments.wLnc", "precise", "neg_rate"))`% (development q 0.01:
  `r p1(m7("complete.wLnc", "dev_q0.01", "neg_rate"))`% and `r p1(m7("fragments.wLnc", "dev_q0.01", "neg_rate"))`%),
  at a cost of `r f1(d_lnc("complete.wLnc"))` and `r f1(d_lnc("fragments.wLnc"))` points of stop
  sensitivity against the release default on complete and fragment lncRNA inputs (development:
  `r f1(d_lnc_dev("complete.wLnc"))` and `r f1(d_lnc_dev("fragments.wLnc"))`).
- Human complete + lncRNA, calls by length: at q 0.01 (release) `r ll("pytd_v7_precise", "ge200")` of
  `r num(ll("pytd_v7_precise", "n_lnc_calls"))` lncRNA calls are at least 200 codons (development:
  `r ll("decoy_q0.01_longgc", "ge200")` of `r num(ll("decoy_q0.01_longgc", "n_lnc_calls"))`); calls of at least
  300 codons: `r ll("pytd_v7_precise", "ge300")`, `r ll("pytd_v7", "ge300")` and
  `r ll("pytd_v7_sensitive", "ge300")` at release q 0.01, 0.05 and 0.2, and
  `r ll("decoy_q0.3_longgc", "ge300")` at development q 0.3.
- `--sensitive` (release): fragments + random stop sensitivity
  `r f3(m7("fragments.wRand", "sensitive", "sens_stop"))`, against
  `r f3(mq("fragments.wRand", "decoy_q0.3", "sens_stop"))` and `r f3(mq("fragments.wRand", "decoy_q0.5", "sens_stop"))`
  at development q 0.3 and 0.5 (not rerun); lncRNA calls `r p1(m7("complete.wLnc", "sensitive", "neg_rate"))`%
  and `r p1(m7("fragments.wLnc", "sensitive", "neg_rate"))`%; random calls
  `r p2(m7("complete.wRand", "sensitive", "neg_rate"))`% and `r p2(m7("fragments.wRand", "sensitive", "neg_rate"))`%.
- Longest ORF of at least 100 codons per transcript (from the LongOrfs output of the development
  runs; LongOrfs is unchanged at release): random calls `r p1(lo100("complete.wRand", "neg_rate"))`%
  and `r p1(lo100("fragments.wRand", "neg_rate"))`%, lncRNA calls `r p1(lo100("complete.wLnc", "neg_rate"))`%,
  stop sensitivity `r f3(lo100("complete.wRand", "sens_stop"))` and `r f3(lo100("fragments.wRand", "sens_stop"))`.
  `r evidence("E22")`.

### Catalogued Ribo-seq ORFs among lncRNA calls

Human lncRNA predictions that end at the stop codon of a GENCODE phase-2 Ribo-seq ORF
(`score_lnc_riboseq_orfs.py`, comprehensive catalogue). The derived release table repeats
`cliff_c200` and `decoy_q0.05`, which reproduce the development table exactly.

```{r ribo}
ribo_all <- bind_rows(ribo_dev %>% mutate(source = "development"),
                      ribo7 %>% filter(grepl("pytd_v7", label)) %>% mutate(source = "release")) %>%
  mutate(frac = lnc_pred_cat / lnc_pred)
ribo_rep <- inner_join(ribo_dev, ribo7, by = c("org", "variant", "label"))
stopifnot(all(ribo_rep$lnc_pred.x == ribo_rep$lnc_pred.y), all(ribo_rep$lnc_pred_cat.x == ribo_rep$lnc_pred_cat.y))
details(ribo_all %>% mutate(frac = round(frac, 4)), "lncRNA calls at catalogued Ribo-seq ORF stops")
check_text("Ribo-seq ORF share of lncRNA calls, min (%)", round(100 * min(ribo_all$frac)), 1, tol = 0.5)
check_text("Ribo-seq ORF share of lncRNA calls, max (%)", round(100 * max(ribo_all$frac)), 2, tol = 0.5)
```

Over all `r nrow(ribo_all)` runs, `r f1(100 * min(ribo_all$frac))`–`r f1(100 * max(ribo_all$frac))`%
of lncRNA predictions end at a catalogued Ribo-seq ORF stop; the release default gives
`r f1(100 * ribo_all$frac[ribo_all$label == "pytd_v7" & ribo_all$variant == "complete.wLnc"])`% on
complete transcripts.

## lncRNAs by GENCODE era

Recomputed for the release runs with `analyses/lnc_holdout/lnc_calls_by_era.py`
(`pipeline/derive/04_release_short_orfs.sh` → `final_v7/lnc_by_era.human.v7.tsv`). The comparator
rows are the same runs as in E04 and reproduce `lnc_by_era.human.tsv` exactly.

```{r era}
era_old <- read_lines(data_path("benchmark", "lnc_by_era.human.tsv"))
era_dev <- tibble(line = era_old) %>%
  mutate(variant = ifelse(startsWith(line, "=="), sub("== ", "", line), NA)) %>% fill(variant) %>%
  filter(!startsWith(line, "=="), !startsWith(line, "tool")) %>%
  separate(line, c("tool", "era", "n_lnc", "n_called", "frac_called"), sep = "\t", convert = TRUE)
chk <- inner_join(era_dev, era7, by = c("variant", "tool", "era"))
stopifnot(nrow(chk) == nrow(era_dev), all(chk$n_called.x == chk$n_called.y))
era_tab <- era7 %>% group_by(variant, tool) %>%
  summarise(pre_v28 = n_called[era == "pre_v28"] / n_lnc[era == "pre_v28"],
            post_v28 = n_called[era == "post_v28"] / n_lnc[era == "post_v28"],
            all = sum(n_called) / sum(n_lnc), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ratio_post_pre = post_v28 / pre_v28)
kable(era_tab %>% filter(variant == "complete.wLnc") %>% arrange(-all), digits = 3)
details(era_tab %>% filter(variant == "fragments.wLnc") %>% arrange(-all) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))),
        "fragments + lncRNA")
e <- function(t, col) era_tab[[col]][era_tab$variant == "complete.wLnc" & era_tab$tool == t]
fe <- function(t) { x <- era7 %>% filter(variant == "complete.wLnc", tool == t)
  fisher.test(matrix(c(x$n_called, x$n_lnc - x$n_called), 2))$p.value }
check_text("TransDecoder lncRNA calls, in GENCODE v28 (%)", round(100 * e("pytd_v7", "pre_v28"), 1), 3.4)
check_text("TransDecoder lncRNA calls, added later (%)", round(100 * e("pytd_v7", "post_v28"), 1), 5.8)
check_text("TransDecoder lncRNA calls, ratio added later / in v28", round(e("pytd_v7", "ratio_post_pre"), 2), 1.68)
check_text("TransDecoder lncRNA calls, Fisher p (x 1e-23)", round(fe("pytd_v7") / 1e-23, 1), 2.4)
check_text("RNAsamba lncRNA calls, in v28 (%)", round(100 * e("rnasamba", "pre_v28"), 1), 6.2)
check_text("RNAsamba lncRNA calls, added later (%)", round(100 * e("rnasamba", "post_v28"), 1), 10.9)
check_text("RNAsamba lncRNA calls, ratio", round(e("rnasamba", "ratio_post_pre"), 2), 1.74)
check_text("CPAT lncRNA calls, ratio", round(e("cpat", "ratio_post_pre"), 2), 0.94)
check_text("CPC2 lncRNA calls, ratio", round(e("cpc2", "ratio_post_pre"), 2), 1.00)
check_text("TransDecoder lncRNA call rate (%)", round(100 * e("pytd_v7", "all"), 1), 4.9)
check_text("CPAT lncRNA call rate (%)", round(100 * e("cpat", "all"), 1), 10.5)
check_text("CPC2 lncRNA call rate (%)", round(100 * e("cpc2", "all"), 1), 7.9)
check_text("RNAsamba lncRNA call rate (%)", round(100 * e("rnasamba", "all"), 1), 9.1)
```

Release default (q 0.05), human complete + lncRNA: TransDecoder predicted an ORF in
`r p1(e("pytd_v7", "pre_v28"))`% of lncRNAs already in GENCODE v28 and `r p1(e("pytd_v7", "post_v28"))`%
of those added later (ratio `r formatC(e("pytd_v7", "ratio_post_pre"), digits = 2, format = "f")`;
Fisher's exact test p = `r format(signif(fe("pytd_v7"), 2), scientific = TRUE)`), and `r p1(e("pytd_v7", "all"))`% overall,
below CPAT (`r p1(e("cpat", "all"))`%), RNAsamba (`r p1(e("rnasamba", "all"))`%) and CPC2
(`r p1(e("cpc2", "all"))`%). With the fixed short-ORF test (development, `pytd_dev_v2`) the rates were
`r p1(e("pytd_dev_v2", "pre_v28"))`% and `r p1(e("pytd_dev_v2", "post_v28"))`% (`r p1(e("pytd_dev_v2", "all"))`%
overall). RNAsamba: `r p1(e("rnasamba", "pre_v28"))`% and `r p1(e("rnasamba", "post_v28"))`%
(ratio `r formatC(e("rnasamba", "ratio_post_pre"), digits = 2, format = "f")`).

Under the q-value rule TransDecoder, which was not trained on any lncRNA annotation, calls newer
lncRNAs more often than older ones, by about the same factor as RNAsamba. The RNAsamba era difference
therefore no longer stands out as a sign of training-data overlap: older lncRNAs may simply be
less ORF-like (for example, better studied or longer-established noncoding genes), and the q-value
rule removes the short marginal calls that previously hid this. `r evidence("E04")`, `r evidence("E25")`.

## Figure 4

Panels (release runs are the filled symbols; development runs keep their earlier role):

- **a, b** human and mouse, complete transcripts (a) and fragments (b) with lncRNA negatives:
  lncRNAs with a prediction against sensitivity for true proteins of 50–99 aa. Solid path: LongOrfs
  minimum 100 → 50 codons with no coding test below 100 codons (development, E04). Open square: the
  fixed short-ORF test (development default). Blue path: release q 0.01, 0.05 (star), 0.2.
- **c** predictions per negative sequence at a 100-codon and a 50-codon minimum (development), the
  fixed test (development) and the release default, on GC-matched random sequences (complete
  transcripts) and lncRNAs.
- **d** human lncRNAs with a prediction by GENCODE era, release default and comparators.
- **e** medians over organisms, all four input types: % negatives with a prediction (log scale)
  against stop-level sensitivity. Grey path: development q sweep 0.01–0.5 (E22). Blue: release
  `--precise`, default, `--sensitive`. Other points: fixed short-ORF test and the longest ORF per
  transcript (≥ 100 and ≥ 50 codons).

```{r fig4-data}
REL_CFG <- c("q0.01", "q0.05", "q0.2")
ab <- bind_rows(sos %>% filter(cfg %in% c("m100", "m90", "m80", "m70", "m60", "m50", "m50+g200")),
                sos7 %>% filter(cfg %in% REL_CFG) %>% select(org, v, cfg, sens_all, sens_short, neg, fp_real, prec)) %>%
  filter(org %in% c("human", "mouse"), v %in% c("complete.wLnc", "fragments.wLnc")) %>%
  mutate(x = 100 * neg / N_LNC[org], y = 100 * sens_short,
         path = case_when(cfg %in% REL_CFG ~ "release", cfg == "m50+g200" ~ "fixed", TRUE ~ "minimum"),
         label = case_when(path == "minimum" ~ sub("m", "", cfg), path == "release" ~ sub("q", "q ", cfg), TRUE ~ ""))
per_neg <- bind_rows(sos %>% filter(cfg %in% c("m100", "m50", "m50+g200")),
                     sos7 %>% filter(cfg == "q0.05")) %>%
  filter((v == "complete.wRand") | (v == "complete.wLnc" & org %in% c("human", "mouse"))) %>%
  mutate(n_neg = ifelse(v == "complete.wLnc", N_LNC[org], N_RAND[org]), per_seq = neg / n_neg,
         group = ifelse(v == "complete.wLnc", "lncRNAs", "GC-matched random sequences"),
         cfg = factor(cfg, c("m100", "m50", "m50+g200", "q0.05"),
                      c("100 codons", "50 codons", "fixed test", "release q 0.05")),
         org_lab = factor(ORG_LABEL[org], ORG_LABEL[ORGS]))
era_plot <- era7 %>% filter(variant == "complete.wLnc", tool %in% c("pytd_v7", "cpat", "cpc2", "rnasamba", "borf", "gmst", "prodigal"))
TOOL_LABEL <- c(pytd_v7 = "TransDecoder", prodigal = "Prodigal", gmst = "GeneMarkS-T", borf = "Borf",
                cpat = "CPAT", rnasamba = "RNAsamba", cpc2 = "CPC2")
ord <- era_plot %>% group_by(tool) %>% summarise(all = sum(n_called) / sum(n_lnc)) %>% arrange(-all)
era_plot <- era_plot %>% mutate(tool = factor(TOOL_LABEL[tool], TOOL_LABEL[ord$tool]),
                                era = factor(era, c("pre_v28", "post_v28"), c("in GENCODE v28", "added after v28")),
                                pct = 100 * frac_called)
qs <- qmed %>% filter(grepl("^decoy_q", label)) %>% mutate(q = as.numeric(sub("decoy_q", "", label)), kind = "dev q sweep")
other <- qmed %>% filter(label %in% c("cliff_c200", "longest_orf_m100", "longest_orf_m50")) %>%
  mutate(kind = recode(label, cliff_c200 = "fixed short-ORF test", longest_orf_m100 = "longest ORF ≥ 100 codons",
                       longest_orf_m50 = "longest ORF ≥ 50 codons"))
relp <- med7 %>% filter(label %in% names(REL_LABEL)) %>% mutate(kind = REL_LABEL[label])
e_dat <- bind_rows(qs, other, relp) %>% mutate(x = 100 * neg_rate, y = sens_stop,
                                               variant = factor(VAR_LABEL[variant], VAR_LABEL[VARS]))
```

REL_C <- TD_C
tradeoff <- function(vv, title) {
  d <- ab %>% filter(v == vv) %>% mutate(org = factor(org, c("human", "mouse")))
  ggplot(d, aes(x, y, colour = org)) +
    geom_path(data = d %>% filter(path == "minimum") %>% arrange(org, as.integer(sub("m", "", cfg))), linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = d %>% filter(path == "minimum"), size = 1) +

}

## Small inputs and presets

Held-out test of `r evidence("E21")` (development code 6b024ca; not rerun at release, see E24 for
the bundled presets). Medians over organisms (human, mouse, *A. thaliana*, *D. melanogaster*) and
replicates. `self_cliff` / `self_decoy` = trained on the input with the fixed test or the q-value test
(q 0.05); `preset_same` = same-species preset from complete transcripts; `preset_samemix` = from
complete transcripts and fragments; `preset_other` = mouse for human, human for the others.

```{r presets}
pm <- presets %>% group_by(set, label) %>%
  summarise(across(c(sens_stop, sens_exact, precision_stop, neg_rate), median), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(input = sub("\\..*", "", set), kind = ifelse(grepl("codingonly", set), "coding only", "half random"),
         size = as.integer(sub(".*\\.[BC]", "", set)))
pv <- function(input, kind, size, label, col) pm[[col]][pm$input == input & pm$kind == kind & pm$size == size & pm$label == label]
tab_p <- pm %>% filter(kind == "half random") %>% mutate(v = sprintf("%.3f / %.1f", sens_stop, 100 * neg_rate)) %>%
  select(input, size, label, v) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = v) %>% arrange(input, size)
kable(tab_p, caption = "stop sensitivity / % random sequences with a prediction")
details(pm %>% filter(kind == "coding only") %>% select(input, size, label, sens_stop, sens_exact, precision_stop),
        "coding-only inputs")
small_rand <- pm %>% filter(kind == "half random", input == "complete", size <= 500, label %in% c("self_cliff", "self_decoy"))
preset_rand <- pm %>% filter(kind == "half random", label %in% c("preset_same", "preset_samemix"))
mix <- pm %>% filter(kind == "half random", label == "preset_samemix")
# cross-clade transfer, per organism (5,000 fragments)
cross <- presets %>% filter(set == "fragments.wRand.B5000", label %in% c("preset_other", "preset_samemix")) %>%
  select(org, label, sens_stop) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = sens_stop)
kable(cross, digits = 3, caption = "fragments + random, 5,000 sequences: other-species vs same-species (mix) preset")
check_text("<=500 seqs, random calls trained on input, min (%)", round(100 * min(small_rand$neg_rate)), 8)
check_text("<=500 seqs, random calls trained on input, max (%)", round(100 * max(small_rand$neg_rate)), 82)
check_text("1,000 seqs, random calls complete (%)", round(100 * pv("complete", "half random", 1000, "self_decoy", "neg_rate"), 1), 0.8)
check_text("1,000 seqs, random calls fragments (%)", round(100 * pv("fragments", "half random", 1000, "self_decoy", "neg_rate"), 1), 3.7)
check_text("5,000 seqs, random calls complete (%)", round(100 * pv("complete", "half random", 5000, "self_decoy", "neg_rate"), 1), 0.6)
check_text("5,000 seqs, random calls fragments (%)", round(100 * pv("fragments", "half random", 5000, "self_decoy", "neg_rate"), 1), 0.3)
check_text("preset random calls, max (%)", round(100 * max(preset_rand$neg_rate), 1), 0.4)
check_text("preset random calls, min (%)", round(100 * min(preset_rand$neg_rate), 1), 0)
check_text("mix preset stop sens complete, min", round(min(mix$sens_stop[mix$input == "complete"]), 3), 0.948)
check_text("mix preset stop sens complete, max", round(max(mix$sens_stop[mix$input == "complete"]), 3), 0.960)
check_text("mix preset stop sens fragments, min", round(min(mix$sens_stop[mix$input == "fragments"]), 3), 0.854)
check_text("mix preset stop sens fragments, max", round(max(mix$sens_stop[mix$input == "fragments"]), 3), 0.875)
check_text("trained on 5,000, stop sens complete", round(pv("complete", "half random", 5000, "self_decoy", "sens_stop"), 3), 0.967)
check_text("trained on 5,000, stop sens fragments", round(pv("fragments", "half random", 5000, "self_decoy", "sens_stop"), 3), 0.880)
check_text("50 complete coding, exact sens trained on input", round(pv("complete", "coding only", 50, "self_decoy", "sens_exact"), 2), 0.81)
check_text("50 complete coding, exact sens with mix preset", round(pv("complete", "coding only", 50, "preset_samemix", "sens_exact"), 2), 0.88)
check_text("complete-only preset, fragments 5,000", round(pv("fragments", "half random", 5000, "preset_same", "sens_stop"), 3), 0.806)
check_text("mix preset, fragments 5,000", round(pv("fragments", "half random", 5000, "preset_samemix", "sens_stop"), 3), 0.873)
check_text("mix preset, complete 5,000", round(pv("complete", "half random", 5000, "preset_samemix", "sens_stop"), 3), 0.956)
check_text("complete-only preset, complete 5,000", round(pv("complete", "half random", 5000, "preset_same", "sens_stop"), 3), 0.958)
check_text("other-species preset, fragments 5,000 (median of 4 organisms)", round(pv("fragments", "half random", 5000, "preset_other", "sens_stop"), 2), 0.72)
check_text("cross-clade preset only (A. thaliana, D. melanogaster), fragments 5,000, max",
           round(max(cross$preset_other[cross$org %in% c("athal", "dmel")]), 2), 0.66)
check_text("cross-clade preset only (A. thaliana, D. melanogaster), fragments 5,000, min",
           round(min(cross$preset_other[cross$org %in% c("athal", "dmel")]), 2), 0.43)  # 1087/2500 = 0.4348; text said 0.44 until 2026-10-30
check_text("human/mouse other-species preset, fragments 5,000, min",
           round(min(cross$preset_other[cross$org %in% c("human", "mouse")]), 2), 0.78)
check_text("human/mouse other-species preset, fragments 5,000, max",
           round(max(cross$preset_other[cross$org %in% c("human", "mouse")]), 2), 0.81)
check_text("same-species mix preset, fragments 5,000", round(pv("fragments", "half random", 5000, "preset_samemix", "sens_stop"), 2), 0.87)
```

- Trained on the input, complete transcripts, 50–500 sequences: `r p1(min(small_rand$neg_rate))`–`r p1(max(small_rand$neg_rate))`%
  of random sequences with a prediction (fixed test or q-value test). With 1,000 sequences
  `r p1(pv("complete", "half random", 1000, "self_decoy", "neg_rate"))`% (complete) and
  `r p1(pv("fragments", "half random", 1000, "self_decoy", "neg_rate"))`% (fragments); with 5,000
  `r p1(pv("complete", "half random", 5000, "self_decoy", "neg_rate"))`% and
  `r p1(pv("fragments", "half random", 5000, "self_decoy", "neg_rate"))`%.
- Same-species presets: random calls `r p1(min(preset_rand$neg_rate))`–`r p1(max(preset_rand$neg_rate))`%;
  with the mixed preset, stop sensitivity `r f3(min(mix$sens_stop[mix$input == "complete"]))`–`r f3(max(mix$sens_stop[mix$input == "complete"]))`
  (complete) and `r f3(min(mix$sens_stop[mix$input == "fragments"]))`–`r f3(max(mix$sens_stop[mix$input == "fragments"]))`
  (fragments), against `r f3(pv("complete", "half random", 5000, "self_decoy", "sens_stop"))` and
  `r f3(pv("fragments", "half random", 5000, "self_decoy", "sens_stop"))` trained on 5,000 sequences.
- 50 complete coding transcripts: exact-CDS sensitivity `r f3(pv("complete", "coding only", 50, "self_decoy", "sens_exact"))`
  trained on the input, `r f3(pv("complete", "coding only", 50, "preset_samemix", "sens_exact"))` with the
  mixed preset and `r f3(pv("complete", "coding only", 50, "preset_same", "sens_exact"))` with the
  complete-only preset.
- Fragments, 5,000: complete-only preset `r f3(pv("fragments", "half random", 5000, "preset_same", "sens_stop"))`,
  mixed preset `r f3(pv("fragments", "half random", 5000, "preset_samemix", "sens_stop"))`; complete,
  5,000: mixed `r f3(pv("complete", "half random", 5000, "preset_samemix", "sens_stop"))`, complete-only
  `r f3(pv("complete", "half random", 5000, "preset_same", "sens_stop"))`.
- Other-species presets on fragments (5,000): median `r f3(pv("fragments", "half random", 5000, "preset_other", "sens_stop"))`
  over the four organisms. This median mixes mouse ↔ human transfers
  (`r f3(cross$preset_other[cross$org == "human"])`, `r f3(cross$preset_other[cross$org == "mouse"])`)
  with the cross-clade transfers human → *A. thaliana* (`r f3(cross$preset_other[cross$org == "athal"])`)
  and human → *D. melanogaster* (`r f3(cross$preset_other[cross$org == "dmel"])`). The text's "across
  clades ... 0.72" therefore understates the cross-clade loss.

## Methods: target-decoy q-values

The q-value paragraphs of `methods_algorithm.tex` give settings rather than measured values. Those
that can be checked against committed data:

```{r methods}
pj <- jsonlite::fromJSON(data_path("benchmark", "presets", "preset_meta", "humanmix", "preset.json"))
rel_q <- c(default = 0.05, precise = 0.01, sensitive = 0.2)  # E24/E25 run labels pytd_v7, _precise, _sensitive
check_text("preset q levels (count)", length(pj$q_levels), 10)
check_text("preset q levels, min", min(pj$q_levels), 0.001)
check_text("preset q levels, max", max(pj$q_levels), 0.5)
check_text("preset strata include transcript length and type", as.numeric(pj$strata == "len_tx_type"), 1)
```

- Presets store `r length(pj$q_levels)` q levels from `r min(pj$q_levels)` to `r max(pj$q_levels)`
  (`r paste(pj$q_levels, collapse = ", ")`); strata `r pj$strata`. The release settings 0.01, 0.05
  and 0.2 are among them.
- Default q 0.05, `--precise` 0.01 and `--sensitive` 0.2 are the settings of the release runs
  scored above (`r evidence("E24")`, `r evidence("E25")`); the numbers that justify them are in
  *One setting*.
- The forward-frame versus all-frame contrast comparison and the long-ORF rule paragraph are
  covered by notebook 01 (E26, E10).
